steps.subject: Could stock counting take less team effort?
steps.plain_text_content: RFID stock work Could stock counting take less team effort? Hello {{first_name}}, Stock counts are important, but the process can become difficult when every piece must be checked manually. GIS247 RFID is designed to help identify and track items during stock work. It can support faster counting, traceability, and fewer manual errors when the hardware and workflow are set up correctly. Explore RFID for jewelry inventory Reply with how often your team performs a full stock count. Unsubscribe from future marketing emails.

steps.subject: Should we review one inventory workflow together?
steps.plain_text_content: Focused review Should we review one inventory workflow together? Hello {{first_name}}, We have covered visibility, RFID, traceability, Zone, and replenishment. The best next step is usually not a broad presentation; it is a closer look at one workflow that matters to your team. If inventory is still a priority, tell us whether you would like to review counting, item movement, locations, or replenishment. If the timing is not right, you can pause or unsubscribe below.
